fields.title: Replace the walk-in cooler compressor and re-audit Mission Street
fields.cause: The cooler runs at 46°F, which failed two critical audit items and is behind the warm-drink reviews; three fixes are past due.
fields.plan: Compressor install on Nov 20; dairy in reach-ins until then; close FM-2215 and FM-2219 this week; re-audit on Nov 21.

fields.title: Cover Capitol Hill’s opening shifts with floaters and hire two baristas
fields.cause: Two openers resigned; 11 of 92 shifts went unfilled and the café closed early twice.
fields.plan: Move two floaters from Fremont and South Lake Union for opens; post two barista roles; review the starting wage against the café on Pine.

fields.title: Reset Venice’s morning rush: a second register and a pastry-case check
fields.cause: Waits of 15 minutes from 7 to 9 am and a pastry-case hygiene complaint took reviews from 4.4 to 3.8.
fields.plan: Open the second register from 7 to 9 am; install the sneeze-guard (FM-2201); add a pastry-case check to the hourly list; reply to the Yelp review.

fields.title: Audit Ballard this week
fields.cause: Last audited Oct 2, 45 days ago; two fixes are open.
fields.plan: Full standards audit on Nov 19; check the espresso-machine leak and the front-door closer.

fields.title: Run a road-works loyalty offer at Oakland Uptown
fields.cause: Broadway road works cut morning traffic by a fifth; sales are 8% under target.
fields.plan: Double loyalty points before 10 am until the works end; sidewalk sign at 20th St; review sales on Nov 21.

fields.title: Retrain Santa Monica closers on the new checklist
fields.cause: Closing items were missed in the October audit.
fields.plan: Done on Nov 11; all four closers signed the checklist.
